schema:name: Triage and Route SF Report (SF-REP-003)
schema:description: Receive the submitted report at the NMRA, issue a confirmation and tracking number to the reporter, assess whether the report indicates substandard/falsified quality defects and/or adverse drug reactions (DE8, DE9), and route to NMRA reviewers and pharmacovigilance workflows. (Section 1.3, Section 2.1, Table 9, Fig. 4, Table 11, PDF 22, 27, 39-43)
